description: This file defines models and configurations for entity tables in the Thingsboard UI, including classes for table columns, configuration, and related types and functions.

classes.name: BaseEntityTableColumn
classes.description: Base class for defining table columns with properties like type, key, title, width, and display options.

classes.name: EntityTableColumn
classes.description: Extends BaseEntityTableColumn, adds content, style, tooltip, and action cell configurations for content columns.

classes.name: EntityActionTableColumn
classes.description: Defines an action column with a specific action descriptor.

classes.name: EntityLinkTableColumn
classes.description: Defines a link column with URL generation and content functions.

classes.name: DateEntityTableColumn
classes.description: A date column that formats date values using Angular's DatePipe.

classes.name: EntityChipsEntityTableColumn
classes.description: A column type for displaying entity chips, optionally with URL.

classes.name: EntityTableConfig
classes.description: Main configuration class for entity tables, managing data source, columns, actions, and related components.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Sets the table component and resets entity details page.

methods.name: getEntityDetailsPage
methods.description: Returns the entity details page component.

methods.name: setEntityDetailsPage
methods.description: Sets the entity details page component and resets the table.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Triggers data reload on the table or details page.

methods.name: isDetailsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the details view is open.

methods.name: getActivatedRoute
methods.description: Returns the current activated route from the table component.
